records.title: Solving systems of diagonal polynomial equations over finite fields
records.mechanism: Classical nonzero solution construction for sufficiently large homogeneous diagonal systems; transfer to specified hidden-polynomial graph states.
records.problem_family: Diagonal power sums over finite fields, and a separately specified quantum level-set-state model.
records.native_applicability: Our constraints are mixed, generally inhomogeneous F3 cubics. Diagonal F3 cubes are linear, unlike the implemented divided cubes.
records.transfer_obligation: Supply a structure-preserving transformation with dimension, existence, normalization and source access accounted for.
records.Chevalley_Warning_caution: Divisibility of the number of roots does not make an arbitrary inhomogeneous target solvable.

records.title: Quantum Advantage via Solving Multivariate Quadratics
records.evidence: Current author withdrawal notice reports a classical attack; historical v1 concerns specified binary quadratic and code-constrained systems.
records.native_applicability: Neither a general MQ advantage theorem nor a mixed ternary cubic solver. A known classical attack must not be ignored.
records.open_question: Audit the actual classical attack before adapting solution-state or coding abstractions.
